classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In the main loop the rank itself calls probe.read_staged on class_a and its latency is accumulated as 'gated'/'class_a_stall_ns' before compute proceeds, so the reading rank stalls on its own single read of each file (one read per file index i).

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b is read by the separate _prefetch multiprocessing.Process feeding a bounded queue while the main loop reads class_a and sleeps for compute_s, so each file's single read is overlapped with computation rather than blocking any rank.
